video_title: Charles Barkley lost his MIND with this TAKE on Luka Doncic 😭

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Barkley's take on the Lakers versus the 2024 Mavericks
quotes.excerpt: This team with the Lakers that he has right now is better than the Dallas team

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I really want to see the Lakers do well. First of all, I am a big Luka fan, a big Austin Reaves fan. I think they are going to be better than people realize. Luka and Kyrie took the Mavs to the Finals. Come on, man. This team is probably better. This team is probably just as good as that team.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: So what he is saying is this team with the Lakers that he has right now, as they are constructed, is better than the Dallas team that went to the Finals.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Is the current version of Luka better than the 2024 version?
quotes.excerpt: This is a better version of Luka.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Luka cannot be a wash. This is a better version of Luka.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Why you say that?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Because he is slimmer. He is leading the league in scoring.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Kyrie Irving and Austin Reaves
quotes.excerpt: Kyrie wins. Is that a wash?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: The next guy is Kyrie Irving and Austin Reaves. Kyrie wins. Is that a wash?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Okay, this is over. It is not even close. Don't even talk about it. It is over.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Walker Kessler and Dereck Lively II
quotes.excerpt: I would take Kessler right now.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Walker Kessler and Dereck Lively II. What type of team do you need for a Luka team? Kessler or Lively?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I would take Kessler right now.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I would take Gafor.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' lack of defensive depth around Luka
quotes.excerpt: The issue with them right now is they don't have enough defenders around Luka.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: You got Grimes and who else? The issue with them right now is they don't have enough defenders around Luka.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Well, their wing is Austin and Quinn. I don't like that. That is a little-ass team. That is a little-ass basketball team.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Eastern Conference is more competitive than the West
quotes.excerpt: You can't just steal wins from the East no more. The East is better.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: You can't just steal wins from the East no more. The East is better. You are not beating a lot of teams in the East this year. You go on the road, you might be getting wins. You take that East Coast road trip, you can come back with no wins.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: You could.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Can the Lakers beat the Phoenix Suns?
quotes.excerpt: Are you confident they can beat Phoenix?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Lakers, are you confident they can beat Phoenix?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Yes. Yes, they can beat Phoenix. But they can get beat by Phoenix, too.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: But that can happen on any given night, though.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's ability to win regular season games
quotes.excerpt: Luka Doncic is good enough to steal your games in the regular season.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: What I am saying to you is that Luka Doncic is good enough to steal your games in the regular season.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: The team isn't good enough, though.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I think the team is good enough. I think they shoot enough, I think they will make enough shots.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Will the Lakers make the playoffs?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Lakers making the playoffs?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: It is hard to bet against Luka, but I am going to say play-in.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Will the Lakers make the playoffs if they play 70 games?
quotes.excerpt: If they both play 70 games, I believe that they'll make the playoffs.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: If they both play 70 games, I believe that they'll make the playoffs, in my opinion.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I thought you said they were going to be play-in.
